Hey gang-

A friend of mine at Dell let me know that they have a few job openings that some of you may be interested in.

> The group that does Hadoop at Dell is looking to hire several programmers, architects, and a product manager. Finding those exact skills is difficult, but I figure there's a ton of "data scientist" types who'd be a good fit (even if they had to learn Hadoop on the job).

Let me know if you'd like me to put you in contact. I have no idea what the salary ranges are, if relocation to Austin would be required or not, or what the time frame on a decision is.

Regards,
Ed
